strings.desc_index: Models for a company Dimension, 111 individual research assignments, published components and Claude/Grok statuses.
strings.h1:
A company Dimension.
From a small team to a group of companies.
strings.lede: A registry of 111 research contours: 82 subject models, 18 landscapes, 10 shared contracts and the composition foundation. Each one declares its boundary, questions, invariants and an acceptance scenario.
strings.box_start_p: Below are selections of published models that exist today. The research program refines their compatibility and creates the missing models. A published specification may carry reviewable-draft maturity; its limits are visible on its card.
strings.h2_start: Start with the components you need
strings.start_p: Hand this text to your AI agent. Company data and access rules stay in your Dimension.
strings.profiles_note: The selections verify package presence and integrity. Compatibility of specific profiles and relations with local master systems are checked at installation. HR, contracts and the legal entity are added only when needed.
strings.profile_components: {n} published components with verified versions and SHA-256.
strings.recipes_note: An extended research selection. It is not declared a fully ready installation package.
strings.registry_p: Queued means an assignment is prepared. Researching means a pass has started. Completion and publication are confirmed separately.
strings.order_p: Claude and Grok research each boundary and its sources independently. Their findings are compared, disagreements are preserved, then schema, semantics, dependencies and scenarios are checked. A finished result is published immediately with an honest maturity status. The registry does not claim that all 111 studies are already done.
strings.notice_p: Specifications and starter selections are available. Joint automatic installation still needs work: a successful download does not mean the Dimension passed validation. A separately verified example of the review model already contains an object and a state record. The next step researches and completes the shared installation core.
strings.b_no_candidates: The boundary and the reuse / extension / new model route are not chosen yet.
strings.b_req_p: Every card is executed together with the full research contract: definitions, fields and cardinalities, lifecycle, sources, data mastership, rights, the five object facets, at least eight invariants, positive and negative examples, dependencies, migration and applicability limits.
strings.b_candidate_small: Semantic fit requires boundary research; a published model does not by itself complete this card.
strings.kinds.subject: Subject model
strings.prompt: Read https://ver.cy/AGENTS.md and https://ver.cy/enterprise/AGENTS.md. Create a company Dimension in my workspace. Pick a minimal selection from https://ver.cy/enterprise/starter-selections.json based on real needs, and verify the current published versions and dependencies. Keep the person, employment relations, membership, work assignments and legal entities separate; preserve sources, rights and unknown facts. Ask only for the missing purpose, owner and access details. Store company data in the agreed location; publishing it on ver.cy is not implied.

RCP-01.name: A small team before formalization
RCP-01.trigger: Several people working together; a legal entity, an office and software are not required.

RCP-02.name: A small services company
RCP-02.trigger: Contracts, customers and settlements have appeared; HR profiles only for real relationships.

RCP-03.name: A software product startup
RCP-03.trigger: The team builds software. The landscape is added when a management question about several products appears.

RCP-04.name: An international group
RCP-04.trigger: Legal, HR, financial and management perimeters differ.

RCP-05.name: Devices and a manufacturing chain
RCP-05.trigger: SKUs, engineering revisions, batches, serialized items, firmware and traceability are needed.

RCP-06.name: A digital platform
RCP-06.trigger: Many products, services and environments with shared infrastructure and operational dependencies.

RCP-07.name: An AI lab
RCP-07.trigger: Research, compute, dataset rights, model artifacts, training/eval runs and the context of use.
